ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Obfuscated PowerShell Code
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious UTF16 and base64 encoded and often obfuscated PowerShell code often used in command lines

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*IAAtAGIAeABvAHIAIAAwAHgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AALQBiAHgAbwByACAAMAB4A.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*gAC0AYgB4AG8AcgAgADAAeA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AC4ASQBuAHYAbwBrAGUAKAApACAAfAAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AuAEkAbgB2AG8AawBlACgAKQAgAHwAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ALgBJAG4AdgBvAGsAZQAoACkAIAB8AC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMQB9AHsAMAB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADEAfQB7ADAAfQAiACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAxAH0AewAwAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMAB9AHsAMwB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADAAfQB7ADMAfQAiACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAwAH0AewAzAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMgB9AHsAMAB9ACIAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADIAfQB7ADAAfQAiACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAyAH0AewAwAH0AIgAgAC0AZgAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMQB9AHsAMAB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADEAfQB7ADAAfQAnACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAxAH0AewAwAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMAB9AHsAMwB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADAAfQB7ADMAfQAnACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAwAH0AewAzAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AHsAMgB9AHsAMAB9ACcAIAAtAGYAI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*B7ADIAfQB7ADAAfQAnACAALQBmAC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AewAyAH0AewAwAH0AJwAgAC0AZgAg.*"))
